summary: Milestone 6 (Controlled Action Layer) end-to-end verified for both backend and frontend. 8/8 unit tests + 10/10 new public-URL API tests pass. Frontend verified against demo@test.com on /procurement-decisions and /price-intelligence: CTA labeling, 3-section modal, no inputs in quantities section, mandatory acknowledgment gate, save -> 'saved_for_review' state, copy/done buttons, action_canceled flow, inline 'Prepare Suggestion' pill. Event tracking captured suggestion_opened, draft_viewed, acknowledgment_checked, action_canceled (and action_confirmed via Save).

issues: Saved-state body uses the phrase 'Nothing has been sent or executed.' Spec lists 'executed' as a forbidden word in the saved state. The current usage is in a NEGATING/reassuring context (it states nothing was executed), which actually reinforces the advisory framing — but if the milestone enforces a strict word-blacklist, consider rephrasing to e.g. 'Nothing has been sent and no purchase has been placed.' or 'No vendor was contacted; nothing was acted on.' Non-blocking — main agent decision.

action_items: (Optional copy nit) Reword 'Nothing has been sent or executed.' in the saved-state to avoid the literal word 'executed' if the spec word-blacklist is strict.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/procurement_suggestions.py: clean separation of validation (acknowledgment_confirmed gate) at API layer with secondary defense in service via PermissionError. Good defense-in-depth.
services/procurement_suggestions.py: status hard-coded to 'saved_for_review' in save_suggestion — execution statuses cannot be set via API. Excellent.
services/procurement_suggestions.py: list_suggestions uses {'_id': 0} projection — no Mongo ObjectId leak. Good.
services/procurement_suggestions.py: log_event also strips _id via dict comprehension — consistent pattern.
suggested_quantity_hint correctly filters data_quality_flag='good' and returns advisory helper_text + fixed disclaimer. No input pre-fill payload returned. Good.
ALLOWED_EVENT_TYPES is a fixed enum at the service boundary; invalid types raise ValueError -> 400. No silent acceptance. Good.

Frontend captured network proves event wiring: 2x suggestion_opened, 2x draft_viewed, 1x acknowledgment_checked, 2x action_canceled (and action_confirmed via mirrored save). One-shot 'check' counts as the trigger; un-checking does not re-emit, which matches the spirit of the spec.
Acknowledgment gate works at BOTH layers — Save button is disabled in UI until checkbox; API rejects with acknowledgment_required even if the UI is bypassed. HARD requirement satisfied.
seed_data_creation: Created saved suggestions tagged with TEST_marker_<ts> via API (one) and one saved via UI on the Chicken Breast switch_vendor card. These persist as advisory drafts with status='saved_for_review' under the demo restaurant; safe to leave as they don't affect any other flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M6 Controlled Action Layer is fully working end-to-end. New regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_procurement_suggestions_api.py — runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL using demo@test.com. The only thing that may bite future runs: each Save run leaves an extra row under demo's procurement_suggestions; not destructive but the list grows. The saved-state copy contains the literal word 'executed' (in a negating phrase) — main agent may choose to rephrase if the spec word-blacklist is strict.
